gaps.explanation: Gap 1,165 is the Street Fund: p8 governmental funds statement Street Fund column Total expenditures 656,675 (Public Works 320,333 + Capital outlay 336,342) vs Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis, Street Fund (p16) Total charges to appropriations 655,510 (236,650 + 82,518 + 336,342). 656,675 - 655,510 = 1,165 (GAAP vs cash basis). All other fund columns tie (General 3,475,061 = p22; Sales Tax 189,588 = p17; Other Governmental 247,932 = p20 29,421 + 218,511). No fix.

p11 proprietary funds statement prints major fund columns Electric, Gas, Water, Sewer, Ethanol with no schedule of their own; only the nonmajor combining statement (p21) is in detail. Added: Electric 4,231,005 + 45,431 + 3,389 + 4,867 = 4,284,692; Gas 1,388,978 + 853 + 577 = 1,390,408; Water 422,896 + 4,005 + 206 = 427,107; Sewer 392,086 + 1,416 + 697 = 394,199; Ethanol 508,040 + 750 + 2,769 = 511,559; total 7,007,965. Schedule 203,797 + 7,007,965 = 7,211,762; remaining 4,686 is a printed difference between the p11 'Other Proprietary Funds' column (Utility sales 207,907, total operating revenues 208,202) and the p21 nonmajor combining statement (Utility sales 203,221 = Solid Waste 195,699 + Meter Deposit 7,522, total 203,516): 208,202 - 203,516 = 4,686, not explained on the pages. Major-fund transfers (p11) are also added here as other financing lines (no business-type transfers gap row): in 39,410 + 191,532 + 309,921 = 540,863; out 556,000 + 227,410 + 80,653 + 148,000 + 459,568 = 1,471,631; net (930,768) = p11 Total.
